rules.text: Returns of unused items in the original packaging will be fully refunded within 60 days with proof of purchase or receipt and valid ID.
rules.quote: Returns of unused items in the original packaging will be fully refunded within 60 days (90 days if you’re a Design Rewards member) with proof of purchase through your Design Rewards account or receipt and a valid ID.
rules.reviewNote: The summary omits that Design Rewards members have 90 days for returns, not 60. The quote specifies 60 days (90 for members), but the summary only mentions 60 days.

rules.text: Design Rewards members have 90 days to return unused items in original packaging with proof of purchase or receipt and valid ID.
rules.quote: Returns of unused items in the original packaging will be fully refunded within 60 days (90 days if you’re a Design Rewards member) with proof of purchase through your Design Rewards account or receipt and a valid ID.

rules.text: Mattresses and box springs cannot be returned.
rules.quote: We are unable to accept returns on mattresses and box springs.

rules.text: Pillows and cushions cannot be returned without all of their tags.
rules.quote: We are unable to accept returns of pillows and cushions without all of their tags.

rules.text: Items marked “All Sales Final” cannot be returned.
rules.quote: We are unable to accept returns of items marked “All Sales Final”.

rules.text: Products delivered by local delivery partners must be returned in-store.
rules.quote: Products delivered by one of our local delivery partners, including Roadie, Instacart, and DoorDash, must be returned in-store.

rules.text: Damaged or defective items must be returned within 60 days (90 days for Design Rewards members) for a refund.
rules.quote: If an item you purchased is damaged or defective, please return it within 60 days (90 days if you’re a Design Rewards member) to your nearest store for a refund.

rules.text: If purchase cannot be verified, store credit is issued based on current price of the item(s).
rules.quote: If we can't verify your purchase, we’ll issue store credit based on the current price of the item(s).

rules.text: Exchanges are not provided; customers may return unwanted products and purchase new items.
rules.quote: We do not provide exchanges, but you're welcome to return any unwanted product and purchase new items.

rules.text: Christmas merchandise returned after December 25 will be refunded at the current price, even with original receipt.
rules.quote: Christmas merchandise returned after December 25 will be refunded at the current price of the items, even with the original receipt.
